meaning.zh:
“勉强维持生计” 或 “维持基本生活”。

这个短语描述了在艰难条件下仅仅是为了生存而努力维持生活的情况。它的起源可以追溯到早期英语文学，当时人们用这个表达来形容在经济困难时期通过各种手段勉力维持身体和灵魂的结合，保证生存下去。
meaning.en: This phrase describes making a living or surviving under difficult conditions. It originated from early English literature, where people used this expression to describe the efforts to keep body and soul together through various means during tough economic times.

lines.en: During the Great Depression, many families barely managed to *keep body and soul together*.
lines.zh: 在大萧条时期，许多家庭勉强维持生计。

lines.en: With his low wages, he can only just *keep body and soul together*.
lines.zh: 靠着微薄的工资，他只能勉强维持生活。

lines.en: After losing his job, he relied on odd jobs to *keep body and soul together*.
lines.zh: 失业后，他靠零工勉强维持生计。
